description: Bounded adaptive sampled-path-gap atlas. The completed pure-PWE multistart experiment supplies M20 seed observations; new points use the unchanged full-path evaluator. Processed COMSOL data is a separately labelled reference layer only and is never used to fit or accept PWE candidates.
scope: Exploratory M20 sampled-path-gap mapping. The contour is an interpolated proposal aid, not a PWE certificate, an M25 validation, a full-Brillouin-zone result, or a COMSOL-calibrated model.
